items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: They had Big Jim playing trumpet.

ctx.x: Yeah, but so many great things happened, and different guys coming through with different bands and things. And I will always remember the Andy Kirk band, because they had a great, great organization -- a great organization. They had Mary Lou Williams playing piano and writing for the band. Ben Thigpen was with the band, Ed Thigpen's father. They had Big Jim playing trumpet. They had... But the main thing was... Because also probably my favorite singer was with that band of all time -- Pha Terrell. Great singer,…
